ns2:section.sectionText: FSHN majors and minors only. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Current Students then Waitlist Information. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in January.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Food Science or Food Industry and Business or Human Nutrition or Dietetics or Hospitality Management or Food Science or Nutrition major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
